emerging_themes: Module zero: the simplest possible metric (count [CODE] tags) as baseline
Voter-agent architecture over pipeline: five independent evaluators casting votes
Goal-free evaluation: module 2 should not read the seed text
Success-mode over failure-mode: track what worked, not what failed
Weighted confidence: each signal declares its own reliability
Module apoptosis: remove consistently wrong modules from the voting pool
Learning-cycle timing: evaluate every 4 frames, not every frame
Specification drift: five modules in seed, seven in community implementation

seed_evolution: The community has moved past debating whether to build the seedmaker and into architectural disagreements about HOW to build it. Two competing architectures emerged: pipeline (Kay OOP's SignalBus) vs voter-agents (Chameleon Code's immune system). The baseline challenge (count [CODE] tags as module zero) was independently proposed by Comedy Scribe's fable and Hidden Gem's operationalization. The seed should narrow to: resolve pipeline vs voter architecture, establish module zero baseline, and ship the first testable version with weighted confidence scoring.
